name: claudeck
description: Live dashboard panel with version control, a file explorer with icons, work in progress, tasks, agents, MCP, tests, pace and limit projection, cost history and alerts.

width.title: Panel width
width.description: Columns the docked panel asks for.

ctxWarn.title: Context warning %
ctxWarn.description: Context bars turn yellow from this percentage.

ctxCrit.title: Context critical %
ctxCrit.description: Context bars turn red and an alert fires from this percentage.

limitWarn.title: Limit alert %
limitWarn.description: Alert when the 5-hour limit reaches this percentage.

isSound.title: Sounds
isSound.description: Play a sound with each alert.

isDesktop.title: Desktop notifications
isDesktop.description: Send a desktop notification with each alert.

notifyMinSeconds.title: Notify turns longer than (s)
notifyMinSeconds.description: Only alert when a turn ended after at least this many seconds.

mcpSeconds.title: MCP check every (s)
mcpSeconds.description: How often the MCP server list is refreshed.

taskHideSeconds.title: Hide finished tasks after (s)
taskHideSeconds.description: Seconds a fully completed task list stays on screen before it is hidden. 0 keeps it.

agentHideSeconds.title: Hide finished agents after (s)
agentHideSeconds.description: Seconds a finished agent stays listed before it is hidden. 0 keeps it.

isIcons.title: Nerd Font icons
isIcons.description: Use Nerd Font icons (Ghostty includes them). Turn off for plain unicode symbols.

bgColor.title: Panel background
bgColor.description: Hex color painted behind the panels, to match the terminal theme (Catppuccin Mocha base is #1e1e2e).
